name: Seasons
description: One dial turns the year: a bright quick spring, a warm wide summer, a dark crumbling autumn and a thin frozen winter, with every blend between, and the year can turn by itself.

params.name: Year
params.description: Where in the year the sound is. It starts in spring and goes round through summer, autumn and winter back to spring, blending from each to the next.

params.name: Turning
params.description: How long one year takes when the year turns by itself. Short is a restless cycle of colours, long is a change nobody notices happening.

params.name: Depth
params.description: How far into the season the sound goes. All the way down is the sound as it came in, all the way up is the season at its strongest.

params.name: Space
params.description: How much of the season's room is heard: quick bright reflections in spring, a long soft haze in summer, a short dull room in autumn, a long thin tail in winter.

params.name: Motion
params.description: How much the season moves: a fast shimmer and a rising tail in spring, a slow sway from side to side in summer, a tumbling and sinking in autumn. Winter stands still.

params.name: Grit
params.description: How much of the season's texture is heard: the top end breaking up in autumn, sparse glassy sparks an octave or more above the sound in winter and early spring.

params.name: Tails
params.description: Stretches or shortens every season's room. The middle is each season's own length, the top makes winter ring for most of a minute.

params.name: Width
params.description: Stereo width of the seasoned sound, on top of what the season does itself: summer is wide and winter narrow. All the way down is mono.

params.name: Turn
params.description: Whether the year turns by itself. Still holds it where Year says, Forward runs from spring to summer, Backward from spring to winter.

params.name: Mix
params.description: Balance between the sound as it came in and the seasoned sound.

origin.note: Written for live-mix on cpp/kit. One year dial blends four characters, each made of a tone pair, a small room, a movement and a texture.
